# (full history, no --squash) and pushed fast-forward only, never forced.
# Fetches use https://github.com/<repo>.git (public, no key); pushes use
# git@github.com:<repo>.git with the deploy key stored in secret <key_secret>.
# Release tags named <tag_prefix><version> are pushed to the mirror as v<version>.
